summary: Read two integer lists named apples and days, both of length n. n is from 1 to 2 * 10000, and every stored number is from 0 to 2 * 10000. On day i, apples[i] new apples appear, and they spoil after days[i] days, so they cannot be eaten once that delay has passed. A day grows nothing only when both entries are 0. At most one apple is eaten per day, and eating may continue after day n while any apple is still fresh. Find the most apples that can be eaten and write that count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
